posts.name: Shreyas Namdeo
posts.cooked:
@hemalatha @AtulPS @Afnan_POD @sayan

Due to a prior engagement, I will be unable to attend the OPPE scheduled on 6th December 2025. As mentioned in the grading policy, I understand that I am eligible to request a postponement to the second date. I also have valid evidence to support my engagement.

Kindly guide me through the procedure to apply for the postponement.what is the procedure

image1459×105 25.2 KB

posts.name: Prakhar Arora
posts.cooked:
Dear student,

Please inform the support team at support@study.iitm.ac.in immediately, and include all the necessary supporting documents.

You will need to convince them of the genuineness of your request.

As a side note, the second OPPE is designed to help students pass the course. While passing will be relatively easy, scoring high marks will be more challenging compared to OPPE 1. This structure ensures that students do not use the additional time as an opportunity for extended preparation.

All the best.

Thank you
Prakhar Arora
Teaching Assistant for System Commands.
